$\begin{align}
x^2 +11 x +24&=0
\\\\
x^2 +11 x&=-24
\end{align}$

Now we want to complete $x^2 +11 x$ into a perfect square.

To do that, we should add $\left(\dfrac{\blueD{11}}{2}\right)^2=\goldD{\dfrac{121}{4}}$ to it:

$x^2\blueD{+11}x + \goldD{\dfrac{121}{4}}=\left(x +\dfrac{11}{2} \right)^2$

In conclusion, the equation after completing the square is written as:

$\left(x +\dfrac{11}{2} \right)^2=\dfrac{25}{4}$
